name: vroom-path
description: Quebra-cabeça do Tito para tablet Android e navegador

scripts.stage:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && cp -r js assets vendor www/
scripts.sync:android: npm run stage:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
